characters.name: Den yngste kongssønnen
characters.description: Den yngste av tolv prinser, utholdende og observant, som alene tar sjansen, dreper uhyret, henter kronene og avslører løgnen når makt og frykt prøver å dysse ned sannheten.
characters.look: A slim, brave prince of about twenty-four with a kind, open face, a fine straight nose, calm green-grey eyes, a ready smile and wavy dark-brown hair to his shoulders, a little stiff with salt. He wears a forest-green sailing jacket over a thick off-white Aran sweater, dark-grey trousers and brown deck boots, with a small gold pin shaped like a ship on his collar.

characters.name: Sjømannen
characters.description: Den yngste kongssønnen i forkledning, i en stor, gammel sjømannsfrakk. Han later som han er en skipbrudden matros, og siden kommer han som selger med en kasse på ryggen.
characters.look: A lean young seaman of about twenty-four in disguise, with a kind face, a fine straight nose, calm green-grey eyes and a few days' dark stubble, his wavy dark-brown hair pushed under a sun-bleached red watch cap. He wears a huge old navy sailor's greatcoat with tarnished buttons that hangs to his knees, canvas work trousers and salt-stained rubber boots.

characters.name: Den yngste prinsessen
characters.description: Den mest stille av de tolv, merket av fangenskapet og trusselen fra Ridder Rød, men modig nok til å peke ut sannheten når kronene kommer fram.
characters.look: A small, slight young woman of about twenty-two with a round, solemn face, a short nose, deep-blue eyes under thick, level brows and a small, determined mouth. Her honey-brown hair is braided into a crown around her head. She wears a simple long cream-coloured knitted dress with a thin gold belt, and a little silver anchor pendant on a fine chain.

characters.name: Fugl Dam
characters.description: En fugl så stor at den nesten fyller gårdsplassen, med fjær som kabler og bark, som spiser fire tønner rug til frokost og flyr kongssønnen forbi yachten.
characters.look: An enormous bird so big that it nearly fills a castle courtyard, shaped a little like a giant gull, with a pale silver-grey back and wings with black tips, a snowy-white head and breast, kind dark eyes, a huge hooked golden-yellow beak and orange webbed feet. Its feathers look like twisted steel cables and strips of bark, and from the back of its neck rises one enormous, stiff copper-red feather as thick as a half-grown spruce.

characters.name: Ridder Rød
characters.description: Styrmannen i den røde seilerjakken, som seiler fra den yngste kongssønnen, tar æren for redningen og sender ut pressemeldingen om forlovelsen selv.
characters.look: A tall, barrel-chested, vain man of about forty with a big square jaw, a cleft chin, a short straight nose held high, small, cold pale-blue eyes and a proud, camera-ready smirk. He has short flame-red hair and a short, pointed flame-red beard. He always wears the same bright red offshore sailing jacket with the collar turned up, over white trousers, navy deck shoes and a heavy gold diver's watch.

characters.name: Storetrollet med tolv hoder
characters.description: Sjefen til trollet på øya. Han sitter pyntet som til fest i en praktfull sal, med tolv hoder som snorker i tolv forskjellige takter, mens prinsessene luser ham.
characters.look: A huge, hulking troll about three times as tall as a man, with rust-red, warty skin, a broad, sagging barrel of a body, very long arms that hang to the floor and short bowed legs. On his thick neck sits a bunch of exactly twelve small heads, packed tightly together like a bunch of turnips, each with a knobbly nose, droopy ears and a wispy tuft of straw-coloured hair. He is dressed for a party in a dark-blue velvet dinner jacket, heavy gold chains and rings on every finger.

characters.name: Trollet på øya
characters.description: Et stort og stygt troll på en benk i slottet av stein og glass. Han gir kongssønnen sverdet og flasken, for han er lei av sjefen sin.
characters.look: A huge, strange troll about three times as tall as a man, shaped like a giant sack of flour, with sloping shoulders, a small head, a big soft belly, short legs and huge webbed feet like a duck's. His skin is a weathered, ruddy tan. He has a nose as long as a cucumber, small unblinking amber eyes, big ears like cabbage leaves and a stiff crest of dark-brown hair standing straight up like a brush. He wears a baggy mulberry-purple knitted jumper and grey work trousers.

characters.name: Trollkongen (øya-slottet)
characters.description: Det store, stygge trollet på benken i slottet av stein og glass, som gir kongssønnen sverdet og flasken for å bli kvitt sjefen sin, og som går i dress og krone når han selv blir konge.
characters.look: A huge troll king about three times as tall as a man, shaped like a giant sack of flour, with sloping shoulders, a small head, a big soft belly and huge webbed feet like a duck's, weathered ruddy-tan skin, a nose as long as a cucumber, small amber eyes, ears like cabbage leaves and a brush-like crest of dark-brown hair. He wears an enormous charcoal suit with a mulberry-purple tie, gold chains across his waistcoat, a fur cape on his shoulders and a gold crown.

characters.name: Trolldatteren
characters.description: Trollets datter. Først er hun en liten, våt hund på en øy, så en vakker og alvorlig ung kvinne som sender faren sin lange blikk. I mange år syr hun skjorter og sengetøy til kongssønnen.
characters.look: A willowy young woman of about twenty-two with pale, milky skin, a long, narrow face, a tiny pointed nose, big silvery-grey eyes, a serious, unimpressed look and long, pale-blonde hair that drifts around her as if she were under water. She wears a long apricot-coloured knitted dress and a thin silver bracelet, and goes barefoot.

characters.name: Kongen
characters.description: Prinsessenes far, som helst vil ha de tolv døtrene rundt seg hele tiden, og som slutter å sove middag da de blir borte.
characters.look: A small, wiry, elderly king with a narrow, kind, crinkly face, a small sharp nose, twinkling blue eyes, wisps of silver hair and a long silver-grey beard braided into two plaits tied with little gold rings. He wears a dark navy suit with a turquoise tie and a silver tie pin shaped like a fish, and soft grey felt slippers.

characters.name: Den gamle damen
characters.description: En nysgjerrig gammel dame i et skjevt hus ved havnen, som spør og graver og ringer alle hun kjenner med nyheten.
characters.look: A short, bustling old lady with a plump little body on thin legs, like a robin, and a long neck that she cranes forward to see everything. She has a sharp little chin, a beaky nose, big curious eyes magnified by thick, round glasses and wispy white hair scraped into a tiny topknot like an onion. She wears a lavender cardigan over a flowered dress, an orange knitted scarf and a patched brown apron with a mobile phone in its deep pocket.

places.name: the Glass Castle
places.look: A big castle on a small rocky island, built of pale grey stone and glass: its walls are almost all windows, tall glass arches between thick stone pillars, so the light inside is sharp and white. Inside is one long hall with a polished stone floor and a long stone bench along the wall; outside, seaweed-covered rocks and smooth grey slabs slope down to the sea.

places.name: the Dark Castle
places.look: A grim castle of dark stone on a rocky shore far across the sea, with heavy square towers, narrow windows glowing gold, and a great arched gate facing the sea. Inside the gate lies a wide paved courtyard with an old grey storehouse on posts in one corner. Dark rocks, seaweed and white surf at its foot.
